entry_fill: fresh positive bid/ask; ask must be <= entry limit; price min(limit, ask plus adverse slippage)
stop_trigger: fresh observed option bid at or below stop
stop_fill: observed bid less market slippage, bounded at zero; overshoot retained
target_fill: fresh observed bid reaches target; fill capped at target limit
profit_protection_and_portfolio_review: existing shared position review and allocator, daily
missing_data: no interpolation or inferred fills; stale marks explicitly carried and new allocation blocked
size_assumption: full-size quote-touch simulation; no market depth or queue guarantee
zero_bid: unexecutable quote; no simulated zero-price sale or invented expiry settlement
daily_position_review_price: executable bid; reported NAV uses quote mark/midpoint
capital_recycling: replacement entries wait for pending exit fills; cash and closing fees reserved
